# ShowIf

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Renders its child only on the pages a predicate accepts.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `PaginationWrapperBase`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new ShowIf()
new ShowIf(Func<PageContext, bool> predicate)
new ShowIf(Func<PageContext, bool> predicate, IElement child)
```

## Properties

- [`Predicate`](#predicate): The page test.

### `Predicate`

```csharp
Func<PageContext, bool> Predicate { get; set; }
```

The page test. `null` means "always render", so a `ShowIf` with no predicate is a transparent wrapper rather than an element that silently disappears.
